featured_reviews.name: Hitanshi Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience. Super average dances - unrealistic rules- songs will be edited and then no changes can be done whatsoever, songs are edited as per Mr Sachin’s wishes- how on earth is that valid?
Super rude behaviour by Mr Sachin towards all my guests and even my parents. Not accommodating towards any changes whatsoever, did not take any feedback, below average dance and over all that all he tried to do was upsell - if you had put such effort in the dance rather than upselling then it would’ve resulted in a better sangeet!
Even the couple dance was below average- super disappointed. Please avoid at all costs if you want your sangeet to go well and need wow factors in your dances. Or be ready to shed around 40-50k for the wow factor for a 2 min dance!
My In laws got their dance choreographed from someone else and that lady charged less than half of what Sachin did and she put 10000-% effort with edits, steps, props, wow factor without charging exorbitant amounts.
To top it off, he asked money for a 45 sec song which I got added in my couple dance saying it will be treated as a separate act.
This was never communicated to me ever! How unprofessional is this? And when I denied giving money he did not send me any of the song edits.
Just too much drama 3 days before my function. Please avoid at all costs.

featured_reviews.name: Jayalekshmi M
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best fitness studios in South Mumbai side. It’s been almost a year attending classes and it has transformed me to a much healthy version of myself. I love attending Pilates, Yin Yoga,  Strength and Cardio sessions!
The community bonding & individual health goal setting makes it worth to be part of Studio 1 Life!
Schedule flexibility is what makes this space unique! Trainers are friendly and qualified, which results in quality sessions.

featured_reviews.name: vaishali mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being part of this studio over the past two years has genuinely been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my health and fitness. I’m noticeably stronger, fitter, and more confident in my abilities than when I first started — and that progress says a lot about the environment here.

The instructors are incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and truly professional. They focus on form, safety, and pushing you just the right amount, so you’re constantly improving without feeling overwhelmed.

What truly makes this place special is the energy. The vibe is positive, motivating, and welcoming, and the variety in workouts keeps things fresh and challenging. Training alongside a driven and encouraging group of people makes every session something to look forward to.

featured_reviews.name: Tanuja Gahane
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently joined the Studio one life by Rebant. The trainers are highly professional, experienced, approachable and pay attention to each and every one around. The studio maintains excellent cleanliness. Infact the classes are cleaned after each session. The sessions are fun, high-energy, and suitable for all fitness levels. The music, atmosphere, and group vibe make exercising feel less like a task and more like an experience. They also provide with flexible timings so you can join with any one of the classes for the day. That feels like the best hour of the day indeed. Kudos to Rebant, Harshita and their team for all the efforts and attention they put in.

featured_reviews.name: Jaya Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
If mornings had a personality, mine would definitely be Studio1 Life.

I’ve been coming here since October’25 mostly for yoga (with a recent Zumba comeback 💃)and honestly, it’s become my favourite part of the day.

The yoga classes with Akshay (and sometimes Rebant) are anything but routine. Every single session feels fresh, thoughtfully designed and just the right mix of challenge and energising. From power yoga to Pilates to yin yoga: each class is like a mini reset button for the mind, body and soul.

What I love most; The instructors are absolute pros, focused, attentive and genuinely invested in you. They keep things engaging without any fluff… it’s fun, but with purpose.

And then there’s Zumba with Rebant, pure joy! It’s not just a workout, it’s a full-on vibe. The music, the energy, the steps… one minute you’re in Mumbai, the next you’re dancing your way through Mexico or Spain 🌍🔥

If you’re looking for a place that makes you want to wake up to the rhythm of your body,  this is it. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Karishma Taurani
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm absolutely loving this workout Studo 1! 🤩 They've got an insane variety of classes - Pilates, yoga, strength training, Zumba... you name it! The trainers are top-notch with full of energy, always pushing me to be my best self. What I love most is the flexibility - no advance booking needed, just show up and get moving. :) Whether you're a fitness newbie or a seasoned pro, this place has got you covered.

If you want a trainer who is not just a rep-counter but a true teacher and motivator, you must train with Nomaan. My perspective on training has completely changed for the better!
